name: website-deploy
description: Deploy static websites to simple-host.app from your coding agent (inline JSON or tar.gz/zip). Every site lives at its own address, https://<site>.<handle>.simple-host.app/, and gets per-site KV, SQLite and file resources with visitor sign-in (orders, RSVPs, surveys, each person's own records); legacy state, lists and declared kinds remain available on Simple Host for existing sites only, built-in server-side visitor analytics, and can be connected to your own custom domain — subdomain via CNAME or apex via A record. Pages are readable by anyone; visitors sign in with Google or an emailed code via the hosted auth.js before saving from a page — this visitor sign-in is separate from the owner's account sign-in, which a page never uses; agents write with an API key anywhere. Bundles a builder skill (plan what to build) and a connect-domain skill. Choose a personal home page and curate its showcase with bio, pins and order.
